Management's Discussion and Analysis For the years ended October 31, 2024 and 2023 (In thousands of Canadian dollars, except share and per share amounts or otherwise stated) Corporate update: Through its Canna Cabana brand, High Tide is the largest cannabis retailer in Canada and the second-largest globally by store count with 191 current operating locations. During calendar 2024, the Company reached the high end of its communicated target to add 20-30 locations. The Company's objective is to add another 20-30 locations during calendar 2025, while generating positive free cash flow, as was the case in the prior year. The Company reiterates its long-term goal to reach 300 locations across Canada.
